verdicts.reason: Both use the same weak structure. The 'Shop Flavours' button is oversized and competes with the headline. The flavour pills are out of the original order, with Blood Orange orphaned on a second row. The right side is a cramped cluster, with legal text jammed into the peach circle. The headline's 'here' nearly touches the Honey Rosemary pill. B adds an inconsistent pill style: Blood Orange uses much smaller text than the other two pills. B also has tighter edge margins (headline at about 15px from the left, tagline and legal text nearly touching the right edge), so A is slightly less broken.
